error: This could not load. Your information has not changed.
empty: Nothing here yet. Keep talking with PAI and this picture will grow.
profileIntro: Built from your words and evidence. You can always correct it.
coverageHelp: Shading means there is evidence. This is not a score.
options: Options you know & myths to check
explainEdit: What should PAI know about this correction?
otherHelp: Your own wording is saved as stated evidence and flagged for catalog review.
documentHelp: Upload in Documents, or attach it in your conversation. PAI will review the evidence.
journeyIntro: A conversation, not a checklist. Revisit any step when your situation changes.
pathsIntro: Understand the path before choosing a place. These are possibilities, not decisions made for you.
pathLoading: PAI is working on this path. You can keep chatting while it checks.
pathEmpty: Explore this path to learn what it involves.
placesIntro: Only for this path. Sources and dates stay visible; missing information stays unknown.
placesConsent: I want to look at places for this path
noPrograms: No verified program information is available yet. PAI will need more evidence before making a comparison.
family: Help me talk this through with my family
chooseHelp: Compare the fit and the trade-offs first. A choice is yours to confirm.
decisionPending: A new path needs a reviewed roadmap before it can be chosen. PAI will not create a decision on your behalf.
planIntro: Your selected roadmap lives here. Applications, deadlines and execution will connect through PAI OS later.
checkinHelp: Come back after trying something, receiving a result, or changing your mind.
privacyHelp: Private interpretation stays with PAI. Nothing is shared with a university here. Per-university consent is required before any future sharing.
lag: PAI is still catching up with recent messages. Your conversation can continue.

eligibility.eligible: Entry rules met — admission is not guaranteed

removeHelp: Remove this active fact from your profile? Its evidence remains in your private history.
deleteHelp: This permanently deletes your app account, conversations, documents and workspaces. Your sign-in provider account is separate. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: I understand this permanently deletes my app data
onboardingRetry: Please retry to finish setting up your profile.
exportScope: Export includes your visible profile, conversation, paths, roadmaps, picture and ratings. Document metadata is included; download the original files from Documents. Private model notes and credentials are excluded.
certaintyReply: My certainty about my direction is {value} out of {max}.
stalePath: Some sources need a fresh check. The older claims are hidden until they are checked again.
